company.shortDescription: Drive Ninja is a software platform that provides tools for the banking and automotive industries.
company.description: Drive Ninja is a Dubai-based software company that develops digital infrastructure and technology solutions for the banking and automotive sectors. The company focuses on building platforms and systems that support financial services, vehicle-related operations, and enterprise workflow management. Its offerings include software tools for process automation, digital transactions, customer management, and operational integration designed for businesses operating in mobility and finance-related industries.
